doc.brief: A model for a numeric value.
doc.md:
A model for a numeric value.

The `GtkAdjustment` has an associated lower and upper bound.
It also contains step and page increments, and a page size.

Adjustments are used within several GTK widgets, including
[`SpinButton`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SpinButton), [`Viewport`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Viewport), [`Scrollbar`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Scrollbar)
and [`Scale`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Scale).

The `GtkAdjustment` object does not update the value itself. Instead
it is left up to the owner of the `GtkAdjustment` to control the value.

clamp_page.brief: Updates the value of the adjustment to ensure that the given range is contained in the current page.
clamp_page.md:
Updates the value of the adjustment to ensure that the
given range is contained in the current page.

The current page goes from `value` to `value` + `page-size`.
If the range is larger than the page size, then only the
start of it will be in the current page.

A [`Adjustment::value-changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:value-changed) signal will be emitted
if the value is changed.

configure.brief: Sets all properties of the adjustment at once.
configure.md:
Sets all properties of the adjustment at once.

Use this function to avoid multiple emissions of the
[`Adjustment::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:changed) signal. See
[`Adjustment.set_lower()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#method:set_lower) for an alternative
way of compressing multiple emissions of
[`Adjustment::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:changed) into one.

get_lower.brief: Retrieves the minimum value of the adjustment.
get_lower.md: Retrieves the minimum value of the adjustment.

get_minimum_increment.brief: Gets the smaller of step increment and page increment.
get_minimum_increment.md: Gets the smaller of step increment and page increment.

get_page_increment.brief: Retrieves the page increment of the adjustment.
get_page_increment.md: Retrieves the page increment of the adjustment.

get_page_size.brief: Retrieves the page size of the adjustment.
get_page_size.md: Retrieves the page size of the adjustment.

get_step_increment.brief: Retrieves the step increment of the adjustment.
get_step_increment.md: Retrieves the step increment of the adjustment.

get_upper.brief: Retrieves the maximum value of the adjustment.
get_upper.md: Retrieves the maximum value of the adjustment.

get_value.brief: Gets the current value of the adjustment.
get_value.md: Gets the current value of the adjustment.

set_lower.brief: Sets the minimum value of the adjustment.
set_lower.md:
Sets the minimum value of the adjustment.

When setting multiple adjustment properties via their individual
setters, multiple [`Adjustment::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:changed) signals will
be emitted. However, since the emission of the
[`Adjustment::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:changed) signal is tied to the emission
of the ::notify signals of the changed properties, it’s possible
to compress the [`Adjustment::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:changed) signals into one
by calling g_object_freeze_notify() and g_object_thaw_notify()
around the calls to the individual setters.

Alternatively, using a single g_object_set() for all the properties
to change, or using [`Adjustment.configure()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#method:configure) has the same effect.

set_page_increment.brief: Sets the page increment of the adjustment.
set_page_increment.md:
Sets the page increment of the adjustment.

See [`Adjustment.set_lower()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#method:set_lower) about how to compress
multiple emissions of the [`Adjustment::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:changed)
signal when setting multiple adjustment properties.

set_page_size.brief: Sets the page size of the adjustment.
set_page_size.md:
Sets the page size of the adjustment.

See [`Adjustment.set_lower()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#method:set_lower) about how to compress
multiple emissions of the [`Adjustment::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:changed)
signal when setting multiple adjustment properties.

set_step_increment.brief: Sets the step increment of the adjustment.
set_step_increment.md:
Sets the step increment of the adjustment.

See [`Adjustment.set_lower()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#method:set_lower) about how to compress
multiple emissions of the [`Adjustment::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:changed)
signal when setting multiple adjustment properties.

set_upper.brief: Sets the maximum value of the adjustment.
set_upper.md:
Sets the maximum value of the adjustment.

Note that values will be restricted by `upper - page-size`
if the page-size property is nonzero.

See [`Adjustment.set_lower()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#method:set_lower) about how to compress
multiple emissions of the [`Adjustment::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:changed)
signal when setting multiple adjustment properties.

set_value.md:
Sets the `GtkAdjustment` value.

The value is clamped to lie between [`Adjustment:lower`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#property:lower)
and [`Adjustment:upper`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#property:upper).

Note that for adjustments which are used in a `GtkScrollbar`,
the effective range of allowed values goes from
[`Adjustment:lower`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#property:lower) to
[`Adjustment:upper`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#property:upper) - [`Adjustment:page-size`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#property:page-size).

lower.brief: The minimum value of the adjustment.
lower.md: The minimum value of the adjustment.

page-increment.brief: The page increment of the adjustment.
page-increment.md: The page increment of the adjustment.

page-size.brief: The page size of the adjustment.
page-size.md:
The page size of the adjustment.

Note that the page-size is irrelevant and should be set to zero
if the adjustment is used for a simple scalar value, e.g. in a
`GtkSpinButton`.

step-increment.brief: The step increment of the adjustment.
step-increment.md: The step increment of the adjustment.

upper.brief: The maximum value of the adjustment.
upper.md:
The maximum value of the adjustment.

Note that values will be restricted by `upper - page-size` if the page-size
property is nonzero.

changed.brief: Emitted when one or more of the `GtkAdjustment` properties have been changed.
changed.md:
Emitted when one or more of the `GtkAdjustment` properties have been
changed.

Note that the [`Adjustment:value`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#property:value) property is
covered by the [`Adjustment::value-changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:value-changed) signal.

value-changed.brief: Emitted when the value has been changed.
value-changed.md: Emitted when the value has been changed.
